commentary: Six activities this week versus seven last week, so technically a step back in volume, but the run going from 8.6 to 9.0 kilometres is the kind of thing Himbo absolutely clocked and is currently telling everyone about at the bar. The swim heart rate climbed from 135 to 143, which means you were working harder in the water — whether that's a fitness push or just a spicy Monday energy is unclear, but either way it counts. The lifting stayed consistent and spread across the week in a way that actually looks more structured than last week's slightly chaotic double-up days, which is the quiet unsexy win hiding inside the flashier run number. One less session but arguably more intentional — Himbo respects it, though he is absolutely going to make you earn back that seventh workout next week.
metrics_commentary: That HRV jumping to 58 against a seven-day average of 48 is your body basically winking at you — something is working, babe. The 9 kilometres in one session and 2000 metres in the pool is a solid week of actually showing up, which honestly is the whole game. VO2 Max sitting at 55.6 is genuinely impressive, the kind of number that means you could outlast most people in the room and still have enough left to be interesting company after. The only nudge is that one run session is a little lean — your cardiovascular base wants more chances to show off, and frankly so do you.
gym_commentary: Four sessions, target hit, no excuses made and none needed. No PRs this week, but that is not the story — the story is that volume jumped from 17,940 kg to 20,753 kg, which means Matt moved significantly more total weight across the week even while the individual lift ceilings held steady, and that is the kind of quiet, unglamorous accumulation that builds something real. The big numbers are sitting pretty: 168 kg on the leg press, 107.9 kg on the trap bar deadlift, 88.7 kg on the bench — solid, grounded, a body that knows what it's doing. Wednesday's session was only thirty minutes, which I see, and I'm not mad, but I am noting it, because the man who painted his toes and showed up anyway deserves to also show up fully.
